step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced and open the Agreement Document.
In theContracts pane, click Work tab and click Doc Fields.
Select the lookup field and click the more options icon (). The following menu options are displayed.

ul.li: Re-mark Field: To re-mark the selected field in the document.
Delete Field: To delete the field.

step.cmd: Click Re-mark on the confirmation dialog that appears. This removes the incorrect doc field and creates a new doc field as marked.

note.p: When you click on the Delete Field option, the selected field's content control is removed and content remains the same in the agreement document or template.
